newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SWIMMING-CHINA WIN WOMEN'S 4X100 MEDLEY RELAY.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-CHINA WIN WOMEN'S 4X100 MEDLEY RELAY.

text.p: China claimed their sixth title of the world short-course swimming championships and their third relay crown with victory in the women's 4x100 metres medley relay on Sunday.
The Chinese quartet came within a whisker of their third relay world record of the championships, finishing in three minutes 57.83 seconds, just 0.10 of a second outside their 1993 world mark.
The Chinese led throughout, with Germany in pursuit over the backstroke and breaststroke legs.
Misty Hyman hauled the U.S. into second place on the butterfly but Le Jingyi kept China in front of American Jenny Thompson on the concluding freestyle.
The U.S. were second in 3:58.94 and Australia third in 4:01.55.
